title: Rules clippings
help: Click a section to expand it; an image opens full size and pages with the arrow keys. A clipping can be a page of the rulebook or a sheet, your own image (via the button, Ctrl+V, or drag-and-drop into an open section), or plain text. Any clipping can be deleted.
all_in_place: the book sections are already in place
section_delete_confirm: Delete the section “{{title}}”? Its clippings go with it: {{n}}. Book pages come back with the “restore book pages” button, uploaded ones don't.
no_sections: No sections. Create the first one and put clippings in it.
section_empty: Empty. Add a book page, an image, or text.
caption: caption
paste_question: Paste the image from the clipboard as a rules clipping?
dirty: The clipping isn't saved — the text will be lost.
